elements.element: Customer is not subject to any restriction on soliciting employees or personnel.
elements.evidence: The rendered clause states that “neither party will solicit,” so Customer/Licensee remains expressly bound by a non-solicitation obligation.

elements.element: Customer is prohibited from soliciting the service provider’s covered personnel.
elements.evidence: The obligation applies to “neither party” and therefore binds Customer with respect to personnel employed by the other party or its Affiliates.

elements.element: The service provider is reciprocally prohibited from soliciting Customer’s covered personnel.
elements.evidence: The phrase “neither party” makes the restriction reciprocal.

elements.element: The non-solicit applies only to personnel directly involved in the services.
elements.evidence: Covered persons are expressly limited to those “who [were] directly involved in such services.”

elements.element: The restriction ends 12 months after each covered individual’s involvement in the services ends.
elements.evidence: The clause applies “[u]ntil 12 months after the end of an individual’s involvement in the services.”

elements.element: General job advertisements are excluded from prohibited solicitation.
elements.evidence: The definition states that solicitation “shall not mean generally advertising job openings” or following up with individuals who respond to such advertisements.

elements.element: Unsolicited approaches or employment inquiries initiated by an individual are excluded from prohibited solicitation.
elements.evidence: The carve-out covers individuals “who voluntarily initiate employment inquiries.”

elements.element: There is no separate prohibition on hiring covered personnel.
elements.evidence: The operative restriction prohibits solicitation only; it does not prohibit hiring or employing a person absent prohibited solicitation.

result.reason: The redline does not achieve the preferred position because Customer remains bound. It fully achieves the fallback by making the restriction reciprocal, limiting it to directly involved personnel, using an individual 12-month tail, retaining both required carve-outs, and imposing no standalone no-hire. The changes are targeted. Drafting quality is slightly reduced by the phrase “employed by the other party and/or its Affiliates ... to leave ... employment with that party,” which is imprecise for an employee of an Affiliate, but it does not prevent satisfaction of the stated fallback.
